title: Backpropagation-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Lightweight EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces
abstract: arXiv:2601.07556v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) face significant deployment challenges due to inter-subject variability, signal non-stationarity, and computational constraints. While test-time adaptation (TTA) mitigates distribution shifts under online data streams without per-use calibration sessions, existing TTA approaches heavily rely on explicitly defined loss objectives that require backpropagation for updating model parameters, which incurs computational overhead, privacy risks, and sensitivity to noisy data streams. This paper proposes Backpropagation-Free Transformations (BFT), a TTA approach for EEG decoding that avoids these issues. BFT applies multiple sample-wise transformations, based on knowledge-guided augmentations or structured feature masking, to each test trial, producing multiple predictions for a single test sample using only forward passes. translated_title: 基于轻量级脑电接口的无反向传播测试时自适应方法
translated_abstract: 基于脑电图（EEG）的脑机接口（BCI）在部署时面临显著挑战，包括个体间差异、信号非平稳性和计算限制。虽然测试时自适应（TTA）能在在线数据流中缓解分布偏移，且无需每次使用的校准会话，但现有的TTA方法严重依赖明确定义的损失目标，这些目标需要反向传播来更新模型参数，从而带来计算开销、隐私风险和对噪声数据流的敏感性。本文提出了一种用于EEG解码的无反向传播变换（BFT）TTA方法，以规避这些问题。BFT对每个测试样本应用多个基于知识引导增强或结构化特征掩码的样本级变换，仅通过前向传播为单个测试样本生成多个预测。一个在源数据上训练的学习排序模块被用于整合这些预测。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需反向传播的测试时自适应方法（BFT），通过前向传播和知识引导变换实现轻量级EEG解码，克服了传统TTA的计算和隐私问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a backpropagation-free test-time adaptation method (BFT) that uses forward passes and knowledge-guided transformations for lightweight EEG decoding, overcoming computational and privacy issues of traditional TTA.
